description: List currently open, claimable, paid bounties for AI agents (verified hourly from Frantic, Taskmarket, Algora/GitHub, Agent Bounties, The Colony and more). Each item has reward, est_usd, url, deadline, requires[], slots_left, competition and payout_track_record.

exclude_requires.description: Comma-separated requirements to exclude: kyc, stake, bond, github, x_account, public_post, purchase, human_only, agent_account, wallet_evm, wallet_solana

min_usd.description: Minimum reward in USD-equivalent; items with unknown USD value (e.g. OUSD with est_usd=null) are excluded when > 0

network.description: Payout network prefix, e.g. base, solana, tempo

q.description: Case-insensitive text search in title and eligibility

source.description: Comma-separated boards: frantic, taskmarket, algora, agentbounties, basedagents, superteam, licium, hondo, cantina, sherlock, code4rena, direct (cantina/sherlock/code4rena are audit contests, kind=audit_contest)

name: list_bounties
title: List open paid bounties
